# Load required library
library(Seurat)

# Read the 10X data from current directory
# Read10X expects directory containing barcodes.tsv, genes.tsv/features.tsv, and matrix.mtx
pbmc_data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
# min.cells: include features detected in at least 3 cells
# min.features: include cells with at least 200 detected features
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc_data, project = "pbmc2700", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Normalize the data
# Normalization method: LogNormalize with scale factor 10000
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Identify highly variable features
# Selection method: vst (variance stabilizing transformation)
# Select top 2000 features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale the data
# Centers and scales the data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)

# Run PCA
# Compute principal components using variable features
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Find neighbors
# Construct k-nearest neighbor graph using first 10 PCs
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Find clusters
# Cluster cells using Louvain algorithm with resolution 0.5
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP
# Compute UMAP coordinates using first 10 PCs
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Visualize clusters
# Create UMAP plot colored by cluster identity
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Load 10X data from current directory
sc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = sc.data, project = "pbmc2700", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Filter cells
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Differential expression analysis between cluster 0 and cluster 3
cluster0vs3.markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = 0, ident.2 = 3, min.pct = 0.25)

# Prepare data for volcano plot
cluster0vs3.markers$gene <- rownames(cluster0vs3.markers)
cluster0vs3.markers$neg_log10_padj <- -log10(cluster0vs3.markers$p_val_adj)
cluster0vs3.markers$significant <- ifelse(abs(cluster0vs3.markers$avg_log2FC) > 1 & cluster0vs3.markers$p_val_adj < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Significant")

# Create volcano plot
ggplot(cluster0vs3.markers, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = neg_log10_padj, color = significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Not Significant" = "grey", "Significant" = "red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value", title = "Volcano Plot: Cluster 0 vs Cluster 3") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# Load required libraries
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Set working directory (adjust as needed)
# setwd("path/to/your/data")

# ===== 1. Load the data =====
cat("Loading data...\n")

# Read the sparse matrix
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Read barcodes (cell IDs)
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(barcodes) <- "barcode"

# Read genes
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "\t")
colnames(genes) <- c("gene_id", "gene_symbol")

# Assign row and column names to the matrix
rownames(matrix) <- genes$gene_symbol
colnames(matrix) <- barcodes$barcode

cat("Data loaded successfully!\n")
cat("Matrix dimensions:", dim(matrix)[1], "genes x", dim(matrix)[2], "cells\n\n")

# ===== 2. Calculate QC metrics =====
cat("Calculating QC metrics...\n")

# Number of genes detected per cell (genes with UMI > 0)
n_genes_per_cell <- colSums(matrix > 0)

# Total UMI counts per cell
n_umis_per_cell <- colSums(matrix)

# Identify mitochondrial genes (genes starting with "MT-" or "mt-")
mito_genes <- grep("^MT-|^mt-", rownames(matrix), value = TRUE)
cat("Found", length(mito_genes), "mitochondrial genes\n")

# Calculate percentage of mitochondrial UMIs per cell
if (length(mito_genes) > 0) {
  mito_counts <- colSums(matrix[mito_genes, , drop = FALSE])
  percent_mito <- (mito_counts / n_umis_per_cell) * 100
} else {
  percent_mito <- rep(0, ncol(matrix))
  cat("Warning: No mitochondrial genes found!\n")
}

# Create QC dataframe
qc_metrics <- data.frame(
  barcode = barcodes$barcode,
  n_genes = n_genes_per_cell,
  n_umis = n_umis_per_cell,
  percent_mito = percent_mito
)

# ===== 3. Visualize QC metrics =====
cat("\nGenerating QC plots...\n")

# Plot 1: Number of genes per cell
p1 <- ggplot(qc_metrics, aes(x = n_genes)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 200, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2500, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Genes Detected per Cell", x = "Number of Genes", y = "Number of Cells") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 2: Total UMI counts per cell
p2 <- ggplot(qc_metrics, aes(x = n_umis)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "darkgreen", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 500, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Total UMI Counts per Cell", x = "Total UMIs", y = "Number of Cells") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 3: Percentage of mitochondrial genes
p3 <- ggplot(qc_metrics, aes(x = percent_mito)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "coral", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Mitochondrial Gene Percentage", x = "% Mitochondrial Genes", y = "Number of Cells") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 4: Scatter plot - genes vs UMIs
p4 <- ggplot(qc_metrics, aes(x = n_umis, y = n_genes, color = percent_mito)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
  labs(title = "Genes vs UMIs", x = "Total UMIs", y = "Number of Genes", 
       color = "% Mito") +
  theme_minimal()

# Save plots
ggsave("qc_genes_per_cell.png", p1, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("qc_umis_per_cell.png", p2, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("qc_mito_percentage.png", p3, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("qc_genes_vs_umis.png", p4, width = 8, height = 6)

# ===== 4. Print summary statistics =====
cat("\n===== QC Summary Statistics =====\n")
cat("Total cells before filtering:", nrow(qc_metrics), "\n\n")

cat("Genes per cell:\n")
cat("  Min:", min(qc_metrics$n_genes), "\n")
cat("  Median:", median(qc_metrics$n_genes), "\n")
cat("  Mean:", round(mean(qc_metrics$n_genes), 2), "\n")
cat("  Max:", max(qc_metrics$n_genes), "\n\n")

cat("UMIs per cell:\n")
cat("  Min:", min(qc_metrics$n_umis), "\n")
cat("  Median:", median(qc_metrics$n_umis), "\n")
cat("  Mean:", round(mean(qc_metrics$n_umis), 2), "\n")
cat("  Max:", max(qc_metrics$n_umis), "\n\n")

cat("Mitochondrial percentage:\n")
cat("  Min:", round(min(qc_metrics$percent_mito), 2), "%\n")
cat("  Median:", round(median(qc_metrics$percent_mito), 2), "%\n")
cat("  Mean:", round(mean(qc_metrics$percent_mito), 2), "%\n")
cat("  Max:", round(max(qc_metrics$percent_mito), 2), "%\n\n")

# ===== 5. Filter low-quality cells =====
cat("===== Filtering Cells =====\n")

# Define filtering thresholds
min_genes <- 200      # Minimum genes detected
max_genes <- 2500     # Maximum genes (to remove potential doublets)
min_umis <- 500       # Minimum UMI counts
max_mito <- 5         # Maximum mitochondrial percentage

cat("Filtering criteria:\n")
cat("  Min genes:", min_genes, "\n")
cat("  Max genes:", max_genes, "\n")
cat("  Min UMIs:", min_umis, "\n")
cat("  Max mitochondrial %:", max_mito, "\n\n")

# Apply filters
cells_pass_filter <- qc_metrics$n_genes >= min_genes & 
                     qc_metrics$n_genes <= max_genes &
                     qc_metrics$n_umis >= min_umis &
                     qc_metrics$percent_mito <= max_mito

# Filter the matrix and metadata
filtered_matrix <- matrix[, cells_pass_filter]
filtered_qc <- qc_metrics[cells_pass_filter, ]

cat("Cells after filtering:", sum(cells_pass_filter), "\n")
cat("Cells removed:", sum(!cells_pass_filter), "\n")
cat("Percentage retained:", round(100 * sum(cells_pass_filter) / nrow(qc_metrics), 2), "%\n\n")

# ===== 6. Filter genes (optional: remove genes not expressed in any cell) =====
genes_expressed <- rowSums(filtered_matrix > 0) > 0
filtered_matrix <- filtered_matrix[genes_expressed, ]

cat("Genes after filtering:", nrow(filtered_matrix), "\n")
cat("Genes removed:", sum(!genes_expressed), "\n\n")

# ===== 7. Save filtered data =====
cat("Saving filtered data...\n")

# Save filtered matrix
writeMM(filtered_matrix, "filtered_matrix.mtx")

# Save filtered barcodes
write.table(filtered_qc$barcode, "filtered_barcodes.tsv", 
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

# Save filtered genes
filtered_genes <- genes[genes_expressed, ]
write.table(filtered_genes, "filtered_genes.tsv", 
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")

# Save QC metrics
write.csv(qc_metrics, "qc_metrics_all_cells.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(filtered_qc, "qc_metrics_filtered_cells.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== QC Complete! =====\n")
cat("Filtered data saved to:\n")
cat("  - filtered_matrix.mtx\n")
cat("  - filtered_barcodes.tsv\n")
cat("  - filtered_genes.tsv\n")
cat("  - qc_metrics_all_cells.csv\n")
cat("  - qc_metrics_filtered_cells.csv\n")
cat("  - QC plots (PNG files)\n")

# Single-cell RNA-seq Analysis Pipeline for 2,700 PBMCs
# Required package: Seurat

# Install Seurat if not already installed
if (!require("Seurat", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("Seurat")
}

library(Seurat)

# Set working directory to where your files are located
# setwd("path/to/your/data")  # Uncomment and modify as needed

# ============================================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================================
cat("Loading data...\n")

# Read the Matrix Market format data
pbmc_data <- ReadMtx(
  mtx = "matrix.mtx",
  cells = "barcodes.tsv",
  features = "genes.tsv",
  feature.column = 2  # Use HGNC symbols (column 2) as feature names
)

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = pbmc_data,
  project = "PBMC2700",
  min.cells = 3,      # Include features detected in at least 3 cells
  min.features = 200  # Include cells with at least 200 detected features
)

cat("Data loaded successfully!\n")
cat("Dimensions:", dim(pbmc), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 2. QUALITY CONTROL (Optional but recommended)
# ============================================================================
cat("\nPerforming quality control...\n")

# Calculate mitochondrial QC metrics
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
pdf("QC_plots.pdf", width = 12, height = 4)
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
dev.off()

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

cat("After QC filtering:", dim(pbmc), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 3. NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================================
cat("\nNormalizing data...\n")

pbmc <- NormalizeData(
  pbmc,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000
)

# ============================================================================
# 4. IDENTIFY HIGHLY VARIABLE FEATURES
# ============================================================================
cat("\nIdentifying highly variable features...\n")

pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(
  pbmc,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 2000
)

# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable features:", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Plot variable features
pdf("variable_features.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
print(plot2)
dev.off()

# ============================================================================
# 5. SCALE DATA
# ============================================================================
cat("\nScaling data...\n")

all_genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all_genes)

# ============================================================================
# 6. RUN PCA
# ============================================================================
cat("\nRunning PCA...\n")

pbmc <- RunPCA(
  pbmc,
  features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc),
  npcs = 50
)

# Visualize PCA results
pdf("PCA_plots.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)
print(VizDimLoadings(pbmc, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca"))
print(DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca"))
print(DimHeatmap(pbmc, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE))
dev.off()

# Determine dimensionality with elbow plot
pdf("elbow_plot.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)
dev.off()

# ============================================================================
# 7. CLUSTERING
# ============================================================================
cat("\nPerforming clustering...\n")

# Find neighbors
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Find clusters
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

cat("Number of clusters identified:", length(unique(Idents(pbmc))), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 8. RUN UMAP
# ============================================================================
cat("\nRunning UMAP...\n")

pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# ============================================================================
# 9. VISUALIZE CLUSTERS
# ============================================================================
cat("\nGenerating visualizations...\n")

# UMAP plot colored by cluster
pdf("UMAP_clusters.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
p1 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) +
  ggtitle("PBMC Clusters (UMAP)")
print(p1)
dev.off()

# UMAP plot with cluster labels
pdf("UMAP_clusters_labeled.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
p2 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 6, pt.size = 0.5) +
  NoLegend() +
  ggtitle("PBMC Clusters with Labels")
print(p2)
dev.off()

# PCA plot colored by cluster
pdf("PCA_clusters.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
p3 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) +
  ggtitle("PBMC Clusters (PCA)")
print(p3)
dev.off()

# ============================================================================
# 10. FIND CLUSTER MARKERS (Optional but useful)
# ============================================================================
cat("\nFinding cluster markers...\n")

# Find markers for all clusters
pbmc_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  pbmc,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)

# Get top 5 markers per cluster
top5_markers <- pbmc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC)

print(top5_markers)

# Save markers to file
write.csv(pbmc_markers, "cluster_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(top5_markers, "top5_markers_per_cluster.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Visualize top markers
pdf("top_markers_heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 10)
DoHeatmap(pbmc, features = top5_markers$gene) + NoLegend()
dev.off()

# ============================================================================
# 11. SAVE RESULTS
# ============================================================================
cat("\nSaving Seurat object...\n")

saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_analysis.rds")

# Save cluster assignments
cluster_assignments <- data.frame(
  barcode = colnames(pbmc),
  cluster = Idents(pbmc)
)
write.csv(cluster_assignments, "cluster_assignments.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ============================================================================
# 12. SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================================================
cat("\n=== ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total cells analyzed:", ncol(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Total genes:", nrow(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Number of clusters:", length(unique(Idents(pbmc))), "\n")
cat("Cells per cluster:\n")
print(table(Idents(pbmc)))

cat("\nAnalysis complete! Check the generated PDF files for visualizations.\n")

# First, let's create a function to automatically assign based on marker expression
assign_cell_types <- function(seurat_obj) {
  clusters <- levels(Idents(seurat_obj))
  cell_type_assignments <- character(length(clusters))
  names(cell_type_assignments) <- clusters
  
  for (cluster in clusters) {
    cluster_cells <- WhichCells(seurat_obj, idents = cluster)
    
    # Calculate mean expression for each marker set
    scores <- sapply(canonical_markers, function(markers) {
      markers_present <- markers[markers %in% rownames(seurat_obj)]
      if (length(markers_present) > 0) {
        mean(colMeans(GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "data")[markers_present, cluster_cells, drop = FALSE]))
      } else {
        0
      }
    })
    
    # Assign cell type with highest score
    cell_type_assignments[cluster] <- names(which.max(scores))
  }
  
  return(cell_type_assignments)
}

# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)

# Read the data
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Assign row and column names
rownames(matrix) <- genes$V1
colnames(matrix) <- barcodes$V1

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Add mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# QC filtering
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalisation
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

# PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Find neighbors and clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Find markers for each cluster
markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Get top 5 markers per cluster
top5 <- markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC) %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(avg_log2FC))

# Heatmap of top markers
DoHeatmap(pbmc, features = top5$gene, group.by = "cluster", size = 3) + 
  theme_minimal()

# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Set file paths (adjust as needed)
barcode_file <- "barcodes.tsv"
gene_file    <- "genes.tsv"
matrix_file  <- "matrix.mtx"

# Read data
barcodes <- read.table(barcode_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
genes   <- read.table(gene_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                      col.names = c("gene_id", "gene_symbol"))

# Read sparse matrix
counts <- readMM(matrix_file)
rownames(counts) <- make.unique(genes$gene_symbol)
colnames(counts) <- barcodes$V1

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Add mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# QC filtering
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalization and variable features
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scaling and PCA
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Find neighbors, clusters, and UMAP
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Define marker gene sets
marker_sets <- list(
  "CD4_T"   = c("IL7R", "CCR7"),
  "CD14_Mon"= c("CD14", "LYZ"),
  "B_cell"  = c("MS4A1"),
  "CD8_T"   = c("CD8A"),
  "NK_cell" = c("GNLY", "NKG7")
)

# Compute module scores for each cell type
pbmc <- AddModuleScore(pbmc, features = marker_sets, name = "Score")

# Assign cell type based on highest module score
score_cols <- grep("^Score", colnames(pbmc@meta.data))
pbmc$cell_type <- pbmc@meta.data %>%
  select(all_of(score_cols)) %>%
  apply(1, function(x) names(marker_sets)[which.max(x)]) %>%
  factor(levels = names(marker_sets))

# Visualize UMAP with cell type labels
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_type", label = TRUE, label.size = 3) +
  ggtitle("PBMC UMAP with Annotated Cell Types")

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Load data
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, col.names = c("gene_id", "gene_symbol"))
counts <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Assign row and column names
rownames(counts) <- genes$gene_id
colnames(counts) <- barcodes$V1

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
pbmc[["gene_symbol"]] <- genes$gene_symbol[match(rownames(pbmc), genes$gene_id)]

# Seurat pipeline
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Differential expression between cluster 0 and cluster 3
de_markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = 0, ident.2 = 3, min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Volcano plot
de_markers <- de_markers %>%
  mutate(gene = rownames(.),
         log2FC = avg_log2FC,
         p_adj = p_val_adj,
         significance = ifelse(abs(log2FC) > 1 & p_adj < 0.05, "significant", "nonsignificant"))

ggplot(de_markers, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_adj), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("nonsignificant" = "grey", "significant" = "red")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: Cluster 0 vs Cluster 3",
       x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-log10 Adjusted P-value",
       color = "Significant")
